ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(StageName) ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Discount_Status__c, "Pending"), ISPICKVAL(Discount_Status__c, "Rejected") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An Opportunity cannot move to Closed Won while Discount Status is Pending or Rejected.
